idea-plugin.name: IssueManager
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the GitHub issues of the open repository as a list in Rider and connects them with branches and worktrees.

  • Issue list in a tool window, with search, sorting and filters, grouped by milestone
  • Description and comments of an issue as a tab in the editor, including images
  • Write a comment, assign an issue to yourself or remove your assignment
  • Open an issue in a new, the current or an existing branch, and switch to its branch
  • Open Rider's "New Worktree" dialog for an issue, and jump to the window of a worktree
  • Texts in English and German, following the language of the operating system

Getting started: configure a GitHub account in Rider (Settings | Version Control | GitHub) and open a project whose origin remote points to github.com. The issues appear in the "Issues" tool window. The plugin uses the account from Rider and needs no token of its own.

Source code and documentation: github.com/MToffano/de.toffano.issuemanager
